WITH obs_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as tel_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_tels AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM telescopes
),
obs_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.observstation,
    oc.tel_count,
    CAST(oc.tel_count AS FLOAT) / tt.total_count as share
  FROM obs_counts oc
  CROSS JOIN total_tels tt
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as mean_share FROM obs_shares
)
SELECT 
  os.observstation,
  os.tel_count as telescope_count,
  os.share,
  os.share - ashr.mean_share as difference
FROM obs_shares os
CROSS JOIN avg_share ashr
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
